p7-dx-dibfusion
# Ports the original actor subclasses now that the base virtuals exist (ledger 28.4).
p7-client-actor-family
p7-db-selectclient
# ---- P8 wave: remaining whole-unit gaps from the ledger section 18.4 triage ----
p8-m2-dummysetting
p8-m2-itemprop-misc
# ---- P9 wave (2026-09-21): the true remainder, reassigned after the P3/P2
# lanes closed.  Every zone below is NEW FILES ONLY (no '!' grants), so a P9
# lane can never touch a file that another writer already owns.
p9-m2-monsters
p9-m2-pathfind
p9-m2-datalayer
p9-m2-forms
p9-rungate-rest
# ---- P10 wave (2026-09-21, round 51): the two giants found by the WEAK triage
# (ledger 38.6b).  GameConfigDlgs.cs carries an explicit, documented seam for
# BOTH dialogs (CreateMirConfigDlg / TJSYConfigDlg stub), so the mirconfig lane
# gets a narrow '!' grant to replace that seam with the real factory.
p10-client-mirconfig
p10-client-scrn
# ---- P10 wave, second batch (ledger 41.8): the DB / Login / LogData remainder found by the
# WEAK triage.  Four projects, all NEW directories; nothing existing is shared with another
# writer.  LogDataServer/ThreadPool is the one unit whose basename repeats with an OPPOSITE
# ruling in the gateways (see tools/unit-map.tsv + the per-copy registry in audit-coverage.ps1).
p10-db-login-forms
# ---- P11 (round 54): READ-ONLY verification lane.  It writes ONE report and nothing else;
# its job is to decide whether LoginGate's 15 E2-only MAPPED verdicts are real ports or
# borrowed-name false positives (ledger 41.2).  No src/ grant at all, on purpose.
p11-logingate-review
# ---- P11 (round 54): closes the ONLY two UNMAPPED units left (GuiManage 474, LoginDlg 179).
# LoginDlg is a self-contained text-DFM dialog -> port it.  GuiManage is coupled to the
# DxComponent<->LoadDx dedup types (ledger 14.4/16.2) -> the lane must ASSESS it first and
# register a blocker rather than invent a second copy of those types (ledger 14.2).
p11-client-dxrest2
# ---- P10 wave, third batch (round 55): the LAST unowned product-UI units.  After this lane,
# every product form/dialog in the tree has an owner except Client-HGE/Login.pas, which ledger
# 18.5#1 deliberately deferred (the launcher EXE is a separate deliverable).
# NB the two binary DFMs (CreateChr, GateSet) must be decoded from Source/** by hand -- the
# _analysis/utf8_mirror copy of a BINARY dfm is corrupted (ledger 41.3-1).
p10-m2-misc
# ---- P12 (round 56): READ-ONLY verification of the E2-only MAPPED giants.  The audit found
# 169 units (488,671 lines) that are counted MAPPED on a header mention alone -- no same-basename
# port.  This lane decides, per unit, whether that claim is real.  Report only; no src grant.
p12-e2only-review
# ---- P11 (round 57): ports the 4 real LoginGate gaps the review lane proved (ledger 44.6).
# HARD CONSTRAINT from that review: SelGate's own headers (SelGateIPAddrFilter.cs:17-25,
# SelGateMisc.cs:11-16, SelGateSession.cs:17-24) declare that its differences from GatewayKit
# MUST be kept, so every new facility has to be OPT-IN and must never unify/replace SelGate
# behaviour.  LoginGate has no test project of its own -> tests go in GXX.GatewayKit.Tests.
p11-logingate-filter
# ---- P13 (round 59): replaces the 1,917 bare `=> true;` stubs inside the 46 ObjMon*Core.cs.
# It gets '!' grants on those EXISTING files on purpose: fixing them in place is the only correct
# move -- creating a second ObjMon implementation would be a third copy of the unit (ledger 14.2).
p13-m2-objmon-real
# (zone widened 2026-09-21: the lane added ObjMonRealSource.cs, a source-LINE reader that lets its
#  assertions quote the real ObjMon.pas line instead of being bare `=> true;` -- that is exactly the
#  right fix for the stub problem, and it is not a second implementation.)
# ---- P13 (round 60): ObjPlayer.pas -- the largest refuted gap (49,232 lines / 4 classes /
# 815 routines) and the documented TPlayObject bottleneck (ledger 18.7).  Its partial port already
# lives in Engine/PlayerSurface/**, so that directory gets a '!' grant: extending the existing
# partial-class files is the only correct move (a second home would be a third implementation).
p13-m2-objplayer
# ---- P14 (round 61): makes the LoginGate opt-in facilities ACTUALLY WIRED (ledger 50.3 item 1:
# "wirable" is not "wired", ledger 33.4).  It therefore gets '!' grants on the wiring points --
# LoginGateService.cs and GatewayKit/GateService.cs -- which are SHARED with SelGate/RunGate, so
# the lane must keep the switch default-OFF and must leave GXX.SelGate.Tests green.
p14-logingate-wire
# READ-ONLY stub census tool (new in round 59, ledger 48.1): makes the silent-stub count visible.
stub-census-tool
